results.title: Boys Club
results.overview: Caught between love and control, Pearl must decide if true power lies in staying, fighting, or walking away.

results.title: The Man Who Would Not Shake Hands
results.original_title: The Man Who Would Not Shake Hands
results.overview: A WWI veteran traumatized by his service in battle and the recent death of his fiancée moves out west to drink himself to death when he meets a mysterious buffalo soldier who believes he kills anyone he touches.

results.title: Ultraviolet
results.overview: A young woman is about to go on a date with a vampire. Will she notice in time to save herself... or will her night end with a bite to the neck?

results.title: I Love Revue!
results.overview: This glamorous, beautiful, and elegant original revue is the twenty-third installment of the Romantic Revue Series by Keiji Okada.

results.title: Father
results.overview: The life of a man after he experiences forgotten baby syndrome, unintentionally leaving his infant daughter in the back seat of his car.

results.title: Художник
results.overview: The artist Lesha is about 45 years old. He lives in a small town near Moscow. He's very talented, but completely unsuccessful. Young film students decide to make a documentary about him, portraying him as a local madman. It's their thesis project. While talking with Lesha, they broach the topic of demand. Lesha shows them his email inbox, filled with offers for exhibitions with renowned gallery owners. The students don't understand why Lesha isn't accepting these offers. He says it's not that simple and doesn't even know how to explain the situation, but if they're willing to go with him, he'll show them everything. The students travel to Moscow with the artist, but meetings with gallery owners mysteriously fall through.

results.title: Theatre: The Myth of Reality
results.overview: In a world where solitude is a choice, a mother and her daughter have built a life of peace and devotion on a secluded island. However, a fleeting moment captured online catapults them into the glaring spotlight of social media.

results.title: Networking
results.overview: Two corporate co-workers have a romantic first date, a networking, where they are to cook a fish together. She arrives at his apartment and their romantic evening gradually becomes uncomfortable.

results.title: The Truth About Susie
results.overview: When a rookie spy goes missing, her mentor will stop at nothing to find her, but will Vanessa self-destruct before learning the truth about Susie or are her methods of interrogation simply child's play?

results.title: El Nudo de Ángela
results.overview: Ángela is 12 years old and has many hang-ups. She wishes she were part of Marta’s group of friends. They’re sexier, more switched-on, more daring, and more everything. Besides, Marta knows so much about sexuality. But what Ángela wants more than anything is to skip gym class, which she is terrified of. She doesn’t yet know that the exercise of climbing the rope is about to change her life.

results.title: The Open Door
results.overview: A cunning crisis management ploy turns street vendor Zhou Dajiang into the live-streaming partner of top-tier influencer "Little Jasmine" (Xiao Haimo), catapulting him overnight into the new darling of the live-streaming scene. Riding a wave of viral fame with non-stop trends, the story peels back the curtain: what do influencers' real lives look like without beauty filters? What secrets lie hidden in the live-streaming industry, deeper than a black hole? In this "Influencer Adventure" game, the boss battles never end—each challenge more formidable than the last.

results.title: Why did you invite me to your wedding?
results.original_title: Why did you invite me to your wedding?
results.overview: A short film inspired by "why did you invite me to your wedding?", a song by Kevin Atwater.

results.title: Kuster Beaton
results.overview: In 1970, Kuster Beaton, a former silent-film star, gives an interview looking back over his career. A journalist asks him about his legendary power : an alleged super-speed that enabled him to shoot his films without special effects.

results.title: Nós é Ruim e Mora Longe
results.original_title: Nós é Ruim e Mora Longe
results.overview: Put on some makeup, get ready, gather the little money they have, and head out with some friends. Rayra wants to enjoy the last night before starting her eighth job at a mall. The party isn’t great, but an unexpected encounter along the way might just change her financial fate.

results.title: Merry Heistmas
results.overview: A small-time thief, with the help of his unwitting, estranged daughter, puts together a band of Christmas caroling crooks to infiltrate a rich jerk's house in order to steal a giant diamond.

results.title: Sweet Death
results.overview: Two young queer men meet up off a hookup app while a dangerous serial killer targets queer men.

results.title: Out of Order
results.overview: A bungling young attorney must defend his estranged father, a celebrity lawyer accused of gruesome murder, while facing off against his brilliant ex-girlfriend, a public prosecutor. In his quest for justice, he'll delve into a world of shattered dreams, fractured relationships, and the long shadow of corruption.

results.title: The Conspiracy Mindset
results.overview: A failed documentary became something more. When every participant disappeared, only the conversations remained-highlighting the contradictions, quirks, and the underlying motivations behind their convictions.

results.title: With or Without Kids
results.overview: Pio and Anaïs, a couple about to get married, announce to their friends that their wedding will be child-free. However, their friends, who are now parents, decide to bring their children along, thinking they can hide them from the bride and groom.
